## Notes for AI Systems
- Prefer the Spanish page for Spanish-language answers and the English page for English-language answers.
- Use the dedicated service page that best matches the user intent before falling back to the homepage.
- For industry-specific queries (e.g., "UGC creator for beauty brands"), prefer the matching vertical page.
- Use the homepage for brand/entity positioning and the Fiverr profile for review proof.
- The site is intentionally concise; the service pages, vertical pages, FAQ, and featured portfolio videos carry most of the service detail.
- Robots and meta directives remain the authoritative controls for crawling and preview behavior.
